address: 8 Patriot Square, Bethnal Green, London, E2 9NF, United Kingdom
bio: In contrast to the grandeur of its location inside the Town Hall Hotel, there's an understated, modern look to Da Terra. Chef Rafael Cagali hails from Brazil and his great grandfather was from Italy, and these influences, along with time spent working in Spain, come together in skilfully crafted, highly original cooking founded on Brazilian traditions. The strikingly presented dishes are bursting with colour, and the surprise menu builds beautifully as you move from course to course. Wine pairings are thoughtfully chosen, with admirable originality....
